name: Yuuki's Father
source:
He and his [url=https://vndb.org/c69537]wife[/url] are happy to tell their [url=https://vndb.org/c69534]son[/url] that he will join the academy of lovers, full of pretty girls. When he sees that his son is not enthusiastic, he fears that his son is [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Gay]on the other side[/url] ...

He loves his wife very much. Maybe too much, he does "things" to her you don't have to do in front of someone ...

[spoiler]Him and his wife call Yuuki on the phone ( once in a while ) once he has chosen a girlfriend. They are always aware of what is going on and know each time who is the happy elect and even more. They are always there to best advise their son.[/spoiler]
